## Capability coverage

capability coverage is unaffected. Use supported, partial, missing, API-blocked,
intentional difference (with reason), or unverified. Link evidence and name an
owner and follow-up for deferred gaps.

## Validation

Describe the behavior/failure cases protected by tests, or why existing evidence
is sufficient. List required gates and results, including dependency policy for
package/pin updates. Identify platform or rendered checks that remain unverified.

## Maintenance impact

Identify canonical documentation/help changes or explain why none are needed.
For cleanup, state the concrete maintenance problem and how behavior is preserved.
For dependency updates, state the upstream reason and compatibility impact.
